trans-unit.source: Replace-URL to show Klaro! Consent Management:Links targeting this placeholder URL are automatically modified before HTML output. The URL is replaced with CSP-compliant JavaScript to trigger the Klaro! Consent Management modal.
trans-unit.target: URL isimbura yo kwerekana imicungire y’ubwumvikane ya Klaro!: Ihuza zigana iyi URL y’ahabigenewe zihindurwa mu buryo bwikora mbere y’uko HTML isohoka. URL isimbuzwa JavaScript yubahiriza CSP kugira ngo ifungure modal y’imicungire y’ubwumvikane ya Klaro!.

trans-unit.source: Replace-URL to reset Klaro! Consent Management:Links targeting this placeholder URL are automatically changed before HTML output. The URL is replaced with CSP-compliant JavaScript to reset the Klaro! Consent Management settings and then trigger the modal.
trans-unit.target: URL isimbura yo gusubizaho imicungire y’ubwumvikane ya Klaro!: Ihuza zigana iyi URL y’ahabigenewe zihindurwa mu buryo bwikora mbere y’uko HTML isohoka. URL isimbuzwa JavaScript yubahiriza CSP kugira ngo isubizeho igenamiterere ry’imicungire y’ubwumvikane ya Klaro! hanyuma ifungure modal.

trans-unit.source: Klaro! Configuration Path:If this path is set, external applications can use the Klaro! configuration generated by TYPO3. For example, a WordPress installation can load the TYPO3-generated configuration from this path. Example: "/klaro-config.js"
trans-unit.target: Inzira y’igenamiterere rya Klaro!: Niba iyi nzira yashyizweho, porogaramu zo hanze zishobora gukoresha igenamiterere rya Klaro! ryakozwe na TYPO3. Urugero, iyinjizaporogaramu rya WordPress rishobora gukura igenamiterere ryakozwe na TYPO3 muri iyi nzira. Urugero: "/klaro-config.js"

trans-unit.source: Replace attributes:Comma-separated list of attributes that should be automatically replaced within the content element of the contextual consent
trans-unit.target: Simbuza ibiranga:Urutonde rw'ibiranga bitandukanijwe na koma bigomba gusimbuzwa mu buryo bwikora imbere mu gice cy'ibirimo cy'ubwumvikane bushingiye ku miterere

trans-unit.source: Main section only:Activate this option if the contextual consent box should be limited to the main content only (without heading and footer).
trans-unit.target: Igice nyamukuru gusa:Koresha iri hitamo niba agasanduku k'ubwumvikane bushingiye ku miterere kagomba kugarukira ku birimo nyamukuru gusa (hatariho umutwe n'epfo).
